column1: All food and non-food contact equipment and utensils shall be smooth, easily cleanable, and durable, and shall be in good repair. MUST CLEAN REPAINT RUSTY METAL RACKS INSIDE WALK-IN COOLER OR REPLACE.

All food and non-food contact surfaces of equipment and all food storage utensils shall be thoroughly cleaned and sanitized daily.  MUST CLEAN AND MAINTAIN THE FOLLOWING: INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR SURFACES OF ALL COOLERS AND FREEZERS, INTERIOR OF STORAGE CABINETS INCLUDING WASHBOWL CABINET INSIDE EMPLOYEE WASHROOM. --- MUST CLEAN STORAGE RACKS INSIDE WALK-IN COOLER WITH MOLD LIKE BUILD-UP.

The floors shall be constructed per code, be smooth and easily cleaned, and be kept clean and in good repair.  INSTRUCTED TO CLEAN AND MAINTAIN FLOORS THROUGHOUT PREP AREA ESPECIALLY ALONG THE WALLS AND IN ALL CORNERS WITH GREASE AND DRIED FOOD DEBRIS ACCUMULATION.

The walls and ceilings shall be in good repair and easily cleaned. NOTED FOOD SPILLS ON WALLS THROUGHOUT FOOD PREP AREA IN REAR. INSTRUCTED TO CLEAN OR REPAINT.---- MUST REPLACE MISSING WALL TILE IN REAR PREP AREA (ACCROSS STEAM TABLE).

Ventilation: All plumbing fixtures, such as toilets, sinks, washbasins, etc., must be adequately trapped, vented, and re-vented and properly connected to the sewer in accordance with the plumbing chapter of the Municipal Code of Chicago and the Rules and Regulations of the Board of Health.  INSTRUCTED TO PROVIDE 3 WORKING DRAIN STOPPERS AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

All food establishments that display, prepare, or store potentially hazardous foods shall have calibrated metal stem thermometers, provided and conspicuous, for refrigerated and hot food units.  INSTRUCTED TO PROVIDE VISIBLE THERMOMETER INSIDE ALL COOLERS AND FREEZERS.

All parts of the food establishment and all parts of the property used in connection with the operation of the establishment shall be kept neat and clean and should not produce any offensive odors.  NOTED REAR OUTSIDE AREA (PATIO) WITH UNNECESSARY ARTICLES, CLUTTER AND LITTER ON GROUND. INSTRUCTED TO CLEAN AND MAINTAIN ALSO MUST REMOVE CLUTTER INSIDE REAR STORAGE/GARAGE.

Between uses and during storage ice dispensing utensils and ice receptacles shall be stored in a way that protects them from contamination.  NOTED ICE SCOOP STORED INSIDE ICE MACHINE. INSTRUCTED TO STORE I A SEPARATE CLEAN CONTAINER TO PREVENT CONTAMINATION.---  INSTRUCTED TO PROPERLY STORED WASHCLOTHS IN A CLEAN BUCKET WITH SANITIZING SOLUTION.
